## TRA Timeline

#### IPO and TRA execution

- 2016-06-15: S-1/A files form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.4
- 2016-07-20: IPO closes; TRA executed (filed as Exhibit 10.3 to 8-K Item 1.01)

#### Tyson acquisition and TRA termination

- 2017-04-25: Tyson merger agreement signed; Section 7.07 caps TRA early-termination payment at $224M
- 2017-06-07: Merger closes; Section 4.01 change-of-control acceleration triggers TRA termination
- 2017-06-09: 8-K reports $223.4M lump-sum early-termination payment to TRA Holders

## Explanation

AdvancePierre Foods Holdings executed a Tax Receivable Agreement at its July 20, 2016 conventional (non-Up-C) IPO, agreeing to pay 85% of the cash tax savings it realized from pre-IPO net operating losses, alternative minimum tax credit carryforwards, and pre-IPO tax basis to OCM FIE, LLC as agent for the Oaktree-affiliated pre-IPO stockholders, with interest at LIBOR plus 200 basis points and a ten-year tail. No amendments were filed. Tyson Foods' all-cash tender offer at $40.25 per share closed on June 7, 2017, triggering the Section 4.01 change-of-control acceleration mechanism written into the contract itself; the resulting present-value lump sum of $223.4M was paid to the TRA Holders (just under the $224M cap set in Section 7.07 of the merger agreement), and the TRA was extinguished mechanically per its own terms, not via a negotiated separate instrument. AdvancePierre became a wholly-owned Tyson subsidiary and the CIK has no further TRA activity. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
